title: Dialogue line
description: films/<film>/audio/dialogue/<line_id>.json: metadata of one recorded line, next to <line_id>.wav (the audio) and <line_id>.txt (the text). Written by audio_mcp's speak (D-036). `hash` covers the text, the voice settings and the model, so the same request never synthesizes twice.

voice.description: The character's voice settings at the time of synthesis.

hash.description: sha256 of the text, voice settings and model.

take.description: Incremented when a line is deliberately regenerated.
